Kill the [[Warrior]] [[boss]] [[Gorgaan Hatemonger]] in [[The Breach]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
| profession = ranger
}}

===Objectives===
* Head to the Breach and kill [[Gorgaan Hatemonger]].
* Return to [[Master Ranger Nente]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 300 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{skill icon|Dodge}}
* {{skill icon|Quickening Zephyr}}

==Walkthrough==
After accepting the quest, travel to the gate west of Nente's original position at the [[Balthazar]] statue and enter [[The Breach]], then travel a short distance northeast to the stone bridge where you will find the [[Warrior]] [[boss]] [[Gorgaan Hatemonger]] on the far side, replacing the usual boss spawn there. He is accompanied by a group of three [[Charr]] including a [[Charr Martyr]] and a [[Charr Overseer]]; however, he can be [[pull]]ed away to engage him alone.

Once Gorgaan has been killed, return to Master Ranger Nente at the Balthazar statue in [[Old Ascalon]] for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"I examined the bodies of those [[Charr]] we slew and discovered something interesting. They are part of the [[warband]] lead by '''Gorgaan Hatemonger''', a particularly nasty Charr with whom I've had a few run-ins. Gorgaan can usually be found near a bridge that spans a chasm of black sludge in the Breach. If you were able to find and destroy him, it would throw any plans his warband had for an attack into disarray. Can I count on you?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Gorgaan will trouble us no more.
| decline = I have other tasks to accomplish first.
| ask = Head to the Breach and kill '''Gorgaan Hatemonger'''.
}}

===Reward Dialogue===
;Master Ranger Nente
:''"It is a mighty deed you have accomplished, '''<Character name>'''. With Gorgaan slain, his warband will fall apart. I am proud to call you my ally."''

==Notes==
* A duplicate Gorgaan Hatemonger may spawn at any of the other boss locations in The Breach, including one within [[compass range]] west of the entrance from Old Ascalon. Killing either version of Gorgaan will complete the quest.
